dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped ring structures exhibit thin, irregular dark perimeters with sharp gradient transitions to lighter centers. The most prominent dorsal-central 'O' annulus has a slightly elongated vertical axis with a jagged outer boundary. Secondary rings to the posterior display a reticulated, chain-like geometry.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, high-intensity white punctate blobs is observed, particularly concentrated at the intersections of the annuli perimeters and clustered along the lower lateral boundary of the patterned region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal annuli form an obtuse triangle. A series of four high-intensity blobs along the anterior-lateral edge forms a nearly linear geometric alignment perpendicular to the primary dorsal-ventral axis.
